tools.name: route_emergency
tools.description: Given a home emergency described in plain words (e.g. "water coming through my ceiling"), returns the matching situation(s): who to call and in what order, first steps, typical costs, and a 24/7 dispatch phone number when one is available for the service vertical. Optionally pass a US state for regi

tools.name: get_scenario
tools.description: Fetch one situation in full: structured answer (who to call, costs, FAQ, sources) plus the complete step-by-step guide as markdown. Use category and slug values from route_emergency or list_scenarios.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: List every published situation with title, category, slug, and canonical URLs.
